mapper.select: SELECT ROLE_CODE, ROLE_NM, USE_YN, ROLE_GROUP, (SELECT DESCRIPTION FROM TB_ROLE_GROUP trg WHERE trg.ROLE_GROUP = tr.ROLE_GROUP) AS ROLE_GROUP_NM FROM TB_ROLE tr ORDER BY ROLE_GROUP,INSERT_DT

SELECT USER_ID, USER_NM, USER_GENDER, (SELECT COMMON_CODE_NM FROM TB_COMMON_CODE_DETAIL tcd WHERE tcd.COMMON_CODE = USER_GENDER AND tcd.UPPER_CODE = 'USER_GENDER') AS USER_GENDER_NM, USER_BIRTH, PHONE_NUMBER, EMAIL, LOCK_YN, DORMANT_YN, MEMBERSHIP, (SELECT COMMON_CODE_NM FROM TB_COMMON_CODE_DETAIL tcd WHERE tcd.COMMON_CODE = MEMBERSHIP AND tcd.UPPER_CODE = 'MEMBERSHIP') AS MEMBERSHIP_NM, INSERT_DT FROM TB_USER ORDER BY INSERT_DT ASC

SELECT USER_ID, USER_NM, USER_GENDER, (SELECT COMMON_CODE_NM FROM TB_COMMON_CODE_DETAIL tcd WHERE tcd.COMMON_CODE = USER_GENDER AND tcd.UPPER_CODE = 'USER_GENDER') AS USER_GENDER_NM, USER_BIRTH, PHONE_NUMBER, EMAIL, LOCK_YN, DORMANT_YN, MEMBERSHIP, (SELECT COMMON_CODE_NM FROM TB_COMMON_CODE_DETAIL tcd WHERE tcd.COMMON_CODE = MEMBERSHIP AND tcd.UPPER_CODE = 'MEMBERSHIP') AS MEMBERSHIP_NM, INSERT_DT FROM TB_USER WHERE USER_ID = #{userId}
SELECT tur.USER_ID, tur.ROLE_CODE, tr.ROLE_NM FROM TB_USER_ROLE tur LEFT OUTER JOIN TB_ROLE tr ON tur.ROLE_CODE = tr.ROLE_CODE WHERE USER_ID = #{userId}
SELECT COMMON_CODE, COMMON_CODE_NM, UPPER_CODE FROM TB_COMMON_CODE_DETAIL WHERE UPPER_CODE = 'USER_GENDER'
SELECT COMMON_CODE, COMMON_CODE_NM, UPPER_CODE FROM TB_COMMON_CODE_DETAIL WHERE UPPER_CODE = 'MEMBERSHIP'
mapper.update: UPDATE TB_USER SET USER_NM = #{userNm}, USER_GENDER = #{userGender}, USER_BIRTH = #{userBirth}, LOCK_YN = #{lockYn}, DORMANT_YN = #{dormantYn}, MEMBERSHIP = #{membership}, PHONE_NUMBER = #{phoneNumber} WHERE USER_ID = #{userId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TB_USER ( USER_ID, USER_PASSWORD, USER_NM, USER_NICKNM, USER_GENDER, USER_BIRTH, PHONE_NUMBER, LOCK_YN, DORMANT_YN, MEMBERSHIP, INSERT_DT ) VALUES ( #{userId}, #{userPassword}, #{userNm}, #{userNm}, #{userGender}, #{userBirth}, #{phoneNumber}, #{lockYn}, #{dormantYn}, #{membership}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP )
